summary: This is an 8-K filing reporting amendments to convertible notes and additional secured debt borrowing. BranchOut Food Inc. added a 9.99% beneficial ownership limitation to its existing convertible note with Kaufman Kapital LLC, and separately borrowed an additional $750,000 under an amended secured promissory note for working capital. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. The filing is a routine debt financing amendment.
